reviewedRules.observed: Football main markets include overtime unless explicitly stated otherwise. Moneyline ties are void. The second listed event team is home.
The Canadian support page defines two-way moneyline ties as a push with the stake returned.
Ontario terms link to the same DraftKings General Betting Rules and Sport Rules routes.
